notes: v585 — LOADING NOW HAS A PULSE. While the server grades, the radar used to show a frozen sentence (‘grading the stored year…’) that looked identical whether the work was 5 seconds in or hung — you told us, and you were right. Every in-flight message now carries a LIVE elapsed timer that ticks every couple of seconds, plus the honest expectation: the FIRST grade of a new day, window or floor computes fresh (usually 30–90 seconds), and every later look on every device is instant from the day’s cache. If the timer ever stops ticking, that — and only that — means something is stuck. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
